item.title: Walmart sponsors Shop with Heroes for kids
item.description: For the second year in a row, Walmart in Minden has sponsored and hosted Shop with Heroes. Last Saturday, area kids greeted first responders at the front door of the store, where they were given $100 gift cards by Walmart manager Rory Fleury and then paired with a Minden police officer, firefighter or emergency medical … Continue reading Walmart sponsors Shop with Heroes for kids

item.title: Cotton Valley celebrates with Christmas Parade
item.description: The rural town of Cotton Valley showcased its Christmas spirit with a downtown parade on Saturday, Dec. 20. Participants and onlookers celebrated the upcoming holiday with cheer, featuring floats highlighting Jesus, red tractors, Santa hats, and plenty of smiles and waves.
